Runs on the original picture before the filter, for example a colour signal with Sharp Bilinear or an LCD grid

With HDR10 input the core\'s own HDR output is switched on as well. For a real HDR signal on the TV, then test the native output under Info → Renderer and HDR details; without it the picture is mapped to SDR.
Whole numbers only where the border stays small, such as on 4K screens; otherwise the picture fills the screen
Filter, strength, shape and scaling apply to this game only
For all games on HDR TVs; the game restarts. SDR white sits at the chosen brightness, like SDR video in HDR.
This device offers no HDR10 surface for OpenGL ES; the picture stays SDR.
Progress since your last save state is set aside as the undo state.
Opens the file browser: open the folder with the BIOS files and choose “Take over game data”. Each file is checked by MD5.
